q.en: What is meant by 'workforce participation rate'?

options.en: The share of population in schools
The share of population that is retired
The share of population that is employed or seeking work
options.as: নিয়োজিত বা কাম বিচৰা জনসংখ্যাৰ অংশ

options.en: The share of population that is illiterate

explanation.en: The workforce participation rate is the share of the population that is working or seeking work.
explanation.as: শ্ৰমশক্তি অংশগ্ৰহণ হাৰ হ'ল কাম কৰি থকা বা কাম বিচৰা জনসংখ্যাৰ অংশ।
